messages:
Jordan (SRE): Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A about the model-routing incident (INC-2026-091). RCA is live here: https://redwood.internal/rcas/INC-2026-091. Using this thread as the short owner/ETA tracker.
Evelyn (eng): Thanks. TL;DR for anyone skimming: a blue/green rollout race caused inconsistent alias-to-variant snapshots between registry and router, resulting in incorrect variant resolution and elevated tail latency for ~4 hours in us-east1.
Marcus (product): Can product get a 2-line customer summary we can hand to AEs and comms?
Jordan (SRE): Suggested customer note: "We experienced elevated tail latency for a subset of customers in us-east1 due to a rollout race that caused variant-resolution mismatch. We restored correct mappings, and are implementing preflight checks to avoid recurrence. No data was lost."
Jamie (CEO): Leadership asks: 1) explicit owners + firm ETAs in this thread; 2) a one-line prevention policy we can publish internally.
Jordan (SRE): Agreed. Owners/ETAs below. Prevention policy (one-liner): "Require atomic alias-lock and registry-router consistency check in CI before any tag/alias changes are accepted."
Jordan (SRE): Action A: Add an alias-lock mechanism to the registry API (prevent concurrent tag writes) — owner: Evelyn (eng) — ETA: 2026-04-06.
Jordan (SRE): Action B: Add pre-deploy consistency check (smoke job comparing registry vs router mappings) — owner: Evelyn (eng) — ETA: 2026-04-02.
Jordan (SRE): Action C: Update router runbook with quick roll-forward/rollback steps and CLI snippets — owner: Nora (obs) — ETA: 2026-03-31.
Jordan (SRE): Action D: Customer outreach + impacted account notifications — owner: Marcus (product) — ETA: 2026-03-30.
Evelyn (eng): I'll open PRs for A+B today. Example preflight script I'm adding to CI: 
```
# check-alias-consistency.sh
REG=$1; ROUTER=$2; ALIAS=$3
reg_variant=$(curl -fs "$REG/aliases/$ALIAS" | jq -r .variant)
router_variant=$(curl -fs "$ROUTER/resolve?alias=$ALIAS" | jq -r .variant)
if [ "$reg_variant" != "$router_variant" ]; then
  echo "alias mismatch: $ALIAS -> reg:$reg_variant router:$router_variant"
  exit 1
fi
```
Marcus (product): tracker-bot, can you pull the impacted accounts list so we can prioritize outreach?
tracker-bot: Impact extract ready: 8 accounts flagged (link: https://ops.redwood/impacts/INC-2026-091).
Nora (obs): I'll add a dashboard tile for alias-resolution errors and a Prom alert for alias-mismatch-rate > 0.5% per-pool. Ticket: https://ops.redwood/tickets/TKT-948
Evelyn (eng): PR opened for alias-lock and preflight: https://git.redwood/eng/PR-4567 — includes unit tests and CI integration. Tagging @Jordan @Nora for review.
Marcus (product): Draft customer message posted to #customer-comms for review: https://redwood.internal/comms/drafts/INC-2026-091-draft. Will update here when sent.
Jamie (CEO): Please ensure AEs are notified for the top 3 revenue accounts immediately after the draft is approved. Leadership wants confirmation when outreach is sent.
Jordan (SRE): I'll sync the follow-up tracker with these owners and ETAs now: https://redwood.internal/allhands/followups/2026-03-31. Marking this thread as canonical for small updates.
Evelyn (eng): Note: I'll include a canary deploy in the PR that exercises alias changes against a staging router to catch races.
Nora (obs): Once PRs merge, I'll add the dashboard tile and link the alert rule here.
Marcus (product): Sent outreach to affected accounts and AEs; link: https://customer.redwood/outreach/INC-2026-091 — tagging here: ✅
Jordan (SRE): Great — thanks everyone. If any owner needs more time, update the all-hands follow-up doc instead of posting multiple ETA edits here. Leaving this thread open for short progress notes. :white_check_mark:
